AI Perspectives

Agentic AI for SMEs: automating cross-border growth

Published October 21, 2025 · By Impact Capital VC Research

Small and mid-sized businesses could gain the most from AI agents. How agents can act as a marketing and export department.

Key takeaways

  • SMEs lack the teams that large firms rely on.
  • Agents can act as an affordable marketing and export department.
  • SME and cross-border markets are large and underserved by AI investors.

Large enterprises can afford agencies, analysts and in-market teams. Small and mid-sized businesses usually cannot — which is why they may benefit most from AI agents.

Agents can research a foreign market, write native-sounding content, publish across channels and measure the response, all for a fraction of the cost of a traditional team. For exporters trying to reach customers abroad, that turns an impossible budget into a monthly subscription.

We back companies that serve these businesses because the market is enormous, underserved and ignored by most AI investors who focus on enterprise contracts.

Frequently asked questions

How can small businesses use AI agents?

Small businesses can use AI agents for market research, content creation, multichannel publishing and performance measurement at a fraction of the cost of hiring a team.
